svg.title: General arrangement blueprint of the Aurelia-class ASV-7 spacecraft
svg.desc: A technical engineering drawing sheet showing side elevation, front view, rear view, plan view, a longitudinal cutaway section, a cross section and an engine detail of a 42 metre crewed orbital transfer and landing vehicle, with dimensions, a numbered systems key, specifications, general notes and a title block.

frame Ti-6Al-4V; hull sandwich 3.05 m inner radius.
